contract: HTTPRoute and GRPCRoute response modifiers on individual weighted backend references

standard.cloudBoundary: Dedicated local Kubernetes envtest API and etcd, installed Octavia WSGI and SQL, Amphora renderer and live HAProxy. Keystone, Neutron, Octavia RPC completion and Amphora agent transport use fixtures.
standard.trafficBoundary: Native HTTP/1.1 and grpcio h2c through separate listeners. Two selectorless Services and fixture EndpointSlices supply real host-local HTTP and grpcio origins. Traffic is measured after each phase converges. The regional control plane and production are outside this qualification.
